title: Funnel splash and Circle invite pages at /join/[slug] still render DAWN marketing pieces

source.ref: Site scan 2026-10-14 (scan nine, thread 'Site scan'), against origin/main eb26a01 and production.

detail: FILED 2026-10-14. THE CONSEQUENCE: app/join/[slug]/page.tsx:7 imports PhotoHero, Statement and Section from components/marketing/marketing-ui and renders a DAWN card (bg-canvas, lift-1) at 131-141; no layout wraps it. Every Circle invite and funnel link a host shares opens in the old design. A Frequency funnel kit already exists in components/frequency/site/pages/funnel/. THE FIX: branch on SITE_DESIGN onto the Frequency funnel kit.
